Great White Shark.note: A large lamnid shark found in temperate coastal and offshore waters.

Tiger Shark.note: A widely distributed requiem shark associated with tropical and warm-temperate waters.

Bull Shark.note: A coastal species known for tolerating both salt and fresh water.

Blacktip Shark.note: A coastal requiem shark recognized by dark markings on several fins.

Caribbean Reef Shark.note: A reef-associated shark occurring in the western Atlantic and Caribbean.

Great Hammerhead Shark.note: The largest hammerhead species, occurring in tropical and warm-temperate seas.

Shortfin Mako Shark.note: A fast, open-ocean lamnid shark with a broad global distribution.

Blue Shark.note: A highly migratory pelagic shark found across temperate and tropical oceans.

Lemon Shark.note: A coastal shark often associated with shallow subtropical habitats.

Nurse Shark.note: A bottom-associated shark commonly found around reefs and shallow coastal areas.

Oceanic Whitetip Shark.note: A pelagic requiem shark associated with warm, open-ocean environments.

Whitetip Reef Shark.note: A small reef shark found across the tropical Indo-Pacific.

Other Shark.note: A broad category used when a record identifies a shark but not a mapped species.

Unknown Shark.note: The source record did not contain enough information for species classification.
